map.身体部位硬度指数测量与评估，提供抗击打训练参考: Measures and evaluates the hardness index of body parts, providing a reference for impact resistance training
map.📖 查看「抗击打评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to impact resistance assessment
map.硬度指数 = 基础值 +（上限 − 基础值）× 训练年限系数 × 频率系数；训练: Hardness index = base value + (upper limit − base value) × training years coefficient × frequency coefficient; the years coefficient is taken from the number of years (0 for less than 1 year, 0.6 for 1 to 3 years, 0.8 for 3 to 5 years, 1.0 for more than 5 years); the frequency coefficient = min(1.5, 0.6 + sessions per week × 0.12); an index of at least 80 is advanced, 60 to 79 intermediate, 40 to 59 beginner and below 40 entry level; training should progress gradually and use protective gear, to avoid injury to the periosteum and soft tissue.
map.武术/格斗抗击打训练：按训练年限与每周频率，估算身体各部位（前臂/胫骨/腹/胸/: Impact resistance training for martial arts and combat sports: from training years and weekly frequency, estimate the hardness index of each body part (forearm / shin / abdomen / chest / thigh / fist surface / palm / head) and quantify the degree of adaptation.
map.训练规划：对比不同部位硬度，定位薄弱处（如腹部、胸部基础偏低），针对性强化；头部: Training planning: compare the hardness of different parts to locate weak spots (for example the abdomen and chest start low) and strengthen them specifically; the head should never be trained for impact resistance.
map.风险提示：硬度指数仅为训练适应度的近似量化，真实抗击打还需循序渐进与专业指导，严: Risk note: the hardness index is only an approximate quantification of training adaptation; genuine impact resistance requires gradual progress and professional guidance, and blindly taking hits is strictly forbidden.
map.算例：训练年限与频率对硬度的影响: Worked example: the effect of training years and frequency on hardness

Hardness index = base value + (upper limit − base value) × years coefficient × frequency coefficient; years coefficient [untrained 0 / 1 year 0.6 / 2 years 0.8 / 3 years 1.0], frequency coefficient = min(1.5, 0.6 + sessions per week × 0.12).
Forearm (base 40 / limit 95): 3 years of training, twice a week → years coefficient 1.0, frequency coefficient 0.84 → hardness = round(40 + 55 × 1.0 × 0.84) = 86 (fairly hard, able to take medium impact); untrained → 40 (weak); frequency 0 → 73.
Chest (base 38 / limit 80): 3 years of training, twice a week → round(38 + 42 × 0.84) = 73 (medium).
⚠️ The head has a base of only 15 and a limit of 40, and impact training there carries extreme risk (possible brain injury), so the tool explicitly advises against it and issues a danger warning.
map.硬度指数怎么算？: How is the hardness index calculated?
map.硬度=基础值+(上限-基础值)×年限系数×频率系数。年限越长、训练越频繁，系数越: Hardness = base value + (upper limit − base value) × years coefficient × frequency coefficient. The longer you have trained and the more frequent the sessions, the higher the coefficients and the greater the hardness; the base and upper limits differ by part (the forearm and fist surface have high limits, the abdomen and chest lower ones).
map.头部为什么不建议练抗击打？: Why is the head not recommended for impact training?
map.头部抗击打极易造成脑震荡、脑损伤等不可逆伤害，远超出训练收益。本工具对头部给出明: Impact to the head easily causes concussion, brain injury and other irreversible harm, far outweighing any training benefit. This tool issues a clear danger warning for the head and advises avoiding it; no gain in hardness is worth the cost to brain health.
